needed.evidence: The area to the left of the road is an unpaved, uneven strip of dirt and rubble rather than a purpose-built sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved, continuous sidewalk on the left side of the road to provide a safe space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The right side lacks a formal sidewalk, with pedestrians walking on a dirt shoulder shared with parked vehicles.
needed.suggestion: Install a dedicated, paved sidewalk on the right side to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: The ground on the left is uneven with loose rubble and debris.
needed.suggestion: Level and pave the left-hand pedestrian area to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: The right-hand edge of the road is unpaved and uneven.
needed.suggestion: Pave the right-hand pedestrian area to ensure a smooth, safe walking surface.

needed.evidence: Pedestrians are seen crossing the road in the carriageway without any designated crossing facilities.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing at high-demand points to provide pedestrians with a safe way to cross the street.
